messages:
maria: FYI customer ACME (private VPC) -> console graphs for that tenant are completely empty since ~2026-03-15. They say API calls succeed and embeddings/usage show up in access logs, but Console shows no datapoints. Ticket: #ACME-4893
ben: thanks — can you paste tenant id + an example request/response? also any recent infra changes? :mag_right:
maria: tenant_id=acme-llm-prod. Example curl from their onprem gateway (redacted):
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-RE-TENANT: acme-llm-prod' \  
  https://private-ingress.acme.company/api/v1/usage
```
Response 200 with body, and our ingress logs show request entry. But console shows no datapoints for same time window.
ingrid: I pulled the raw telemetry bundle for that tenant. I can see compute and token logs in the access plane, but the metrics aggregator dropped the telemetry because the request lacked a canonical "tenant_id" when it hit the auth-proxy layer. The auth-proxy is replacing X-RE-TENANT with a JWT claim mapping (sub->tenant) during the OIDC swap we rolled last week.
alex: do we have an example of the request headers at the drop point?
ingrid: yes — from sidecar-ingress debug logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-15T21:14:02Z] INGRESS recv headers: Authorization: Bearer <ok>
[2026-03-15T21:14:02Z] INGRESS recv headers: x-request-id: r-123
[2026-03-15T21:14:02Z] INGRESS recv headers: x-re-tenant: acme-llm-prod
[2026-03-15T21:14:02Z] AUTH-PROXY outgoing headers: Authorization: Bearer <ok>
[2026-03-15T21:14:02Z] AUTH-PROXY outgoing headers: x-request-id: r-123
[2026-03-15T21:14:02Z] AUTH-PROXY outgoing headers: x-re-tenant: (removed)
[2026-03-15T21:14:02Z] AUTH-PROXY outgoing headers: x-re-tenant-claim: "acme-llm-prod"
```
ingrid: aggregator expects `x-re-tenant` header for tenant routing in the metrics ingest pipeline. The auth-proxy used to preserve headers; after the OIDC claim mapping change it strips the literal header and injects `x-re-tenant-claim`. The mapping layer downstream wasn't updated to read the claim header.
ben: that explains why access logs (which read JWT subject) look fine but console metric join (which uses header-based routing) returns nothing. Good find.
maria: customer asked if this is a data loss — do we still have the raw telemetry? can we backfill the console?
ingrid: raw events are in Kafka topic raw-telemetry-2026 for the time window. They include tenant claim in the `jwt_claims` field. We can backfill by running the metrics-join job with a one-off transform to map `jwt_claims.sub` -> tenant_id for events in that window. It won't be realtime but will populate historical charts.
ben: ops, can you flip auth-proxy to preserve the header again while we do backfill and patch aggregator? Proposed quick mitigations: 1) set `preserve_headers: true` on auth-proxy 2) deploy aggregator patch to accept `x-re-tenant-claim` 3) run backfill job.
ops-bot: Starting rollback playbook: runbook-preserve-headers v2. ETA ~12m. :gear:
telemetry-bot: metrics-join resumed for tenant=acme-llm-prod at 2026-03-15T21:32:10Z — ingest showing 14 new datapoints appended (backfill in progress).
ben: great. Maria, please let customer know we found header canonicalization change in auth-proxy rollout that prevented metrics routing. We'll do a short rollback to restore header preservation, patch aggregator to accept claim header, and run a backfill to repopulate missing data. Expect charts to start filling within ~20–40m.
maria: sending update to customer now. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
